query: I was walking my golden retriever this morning and he decided to roll in a big patch of dandelions, so I had to stop by the pet groomer on my way home to get him bathed, and they told me they’re running a 20% off sale on nail trims this week so I signed up for that too. Oh and also I ran into my old high school lab partner at the groomer, we caught up for 10 minutes and she told me she just started a new job as a pastry chef at that new bakery downtown that sells those matcha croissants everyone’s been posting about. Anyway, I’ve been having issues with my phone lately: airplane mode is stuck on, my network connection is really bad, the wifi calling isn’t working right, the storage permissions for my apps seem to be broken, and I think my SIM card might be unseated, can you help me fix these problems?
